YOU BUY! YOU FIX! YOU SAVE OR BUILD YOU DREAM HOME! Welcome to your new home in vibrant highly desirable excelsior District of San Francisco This charming fixer upper, 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom residence offers 815 sq ft of living space, perfectly situated on a lot of approximately 2,500 sq ft. The kitchen is equipped with modern amenities including a stone countertop, dishwasher, built-in oven range with gas stove, and refrigerator. 



Located within the San Francisco Unified School District, this home offers easy access to all the city's amenities. Make this delightful property your new sanctuary in the heart of San Francisco.
